attempted_claim: Let W = W^-(1,2) be the Akbulut-Kirby Mazur-type contractible Stein cork with standard palindromic boundary involution tau on Y=partial W. Then tau does not extend to a diffeomorphism of W, witnessed by d_lower(Y,tau) < d(Y,s_0) together with the Stein handlebody certificate of W.
claim_type: involutive Floer non-extendability witness distinguishing an exotic cork pair
